derivedFrom: src/engine/content/abilities.ts (ABILITY_DEFS, TECHNIQUES), src/engine/content/tasks.ts (TASK_PROFILES), src/engine/content/approaches.ts, src/engine/systems/{attributes,practice,school,coursework,production,briefs,piece,ensemble,life,workbook,playreading}.ts; effects from tools/ag-baseline.ts (baseline.json, section 1)

commonRules.scale: 0 to 100 on one scale; stamina is full at ceilingAt(age).fitness (attributes.ts:155), every other ability at 100; a technique counts as mastered at 90 (abilities.ts:160) and is read as min(1, level/90) (evaluation.ts:266)
commonRules.deliberateGain: abilityGain, attributes.ts:201-207: max(0.42*w*f*max(0,1-L/reach)^1.5, 0.42*w*f*max(0.25, 1-L/100)) points an hour; reach 100 for practice
commonRules.ordinaryGain: develop with deliberate:false toward reachOf (school.ts:950): a craft skill's ceiling (admission + 26, CEILING school.ts:876), the kin's mean for listening, imagination, focus, adaptability, 100 for the rest
commonRules.classGain: grow, school.ts:991: craft[skill] += 0.42*w*focus*max(0,1-L/ceiling)^1.5 (sessionGain school.ts:905); no same-day halving, no discipline lift, never past the ceiling
commonRules.sameDay: each repeat of one source on one target the same day keeps half (DEVELOPMENT.repeat 0.5, attributes.ts:281), develop path only
commonRules.dailyCap: practice.exercise refused at 4 hours a day (practice.ts:61, PRACTICE.dailyHours content/practice.ts:138)
commonRules.disciplineLift: every develop gain x (1 + 0.1*(discipline-50)/50), attributes.ts:280; not applied to grow or nudge
commonRules.dayFocus: focusAt = clamp(readiness/80 * hourFit, 0.3, 1.2), school.ts:910-929: the day's focus, a different thing from the Focus ability; every step and session reads it, no ability does
commonRules.evaluation: an ability's term is level/full inside a dimension's weighted mean (evaluation.ts:259-284); abilities a task does not read change nothing (tests/briefs.test.ts:88, tests/evaluation.test.ts:138)
commonRules.conditionReach: fatigue under readiness 60, the flu, an injury and a concussion reach the dimensions their task names (evaluation.ts:344-356); no ability changes how a condition reaches the work, except stamina's drain inside a piece (piece.ts:276) and composure and adaptability's recovery after a slip (piece.ts:257, 297)
commonRules.decay: none, but stamina: held 3 days after a workout, then -0.18 a day to 35 (life.ts:84, 103, 974)
